correctness.rationale: The Drury–Arveson degree-n multipliers have bosonic creation/annihilation forms S_i=a_i^*/sqrt(n+1), S_i^*=a_i/sqrt(n). The exact commutation identity L_n=(I+n R_n)/(n+1) makes L_n and R_n simultaneous functions of the row Gram matrix. The creation row V_n has V_n^*V_n=(n+d-1)I on H_(n-1), so R_n has eigenvalues 0 and (n+d-1)/n with multiplicities d h_n-h_(n-1) and h_(n-1). This yields positive c_n=1/sqrt(n+1) and negative delta_n=sqrt((n+d)/(n+1))-sqrt((n+d-1)/n); each tends to 0, giving compact injective D. Cumulative multiplicities asymptote ((d-1)/d!)n^d and n^d/d!, giving singular-value exponents 1/(2d) and 2/d, sharp Schatten p thresholds 2d and d/2 and logarithmic constants. Independently built full homogeneous blocks and their roots for d=2..4,n=0..4, matching spectra. Note finite blocks do not prove infinite operator spectral completeness; orthogonal direct sums and counting do. The result is more than a sign check and provides a natural compact-operator spectral invariant.
